name: Lock N Roll Storage
summary: Lock N Roll on Earl Rudder Freeway lists climate rooms, interior rooms, and vehicle parking. Checked Nov 28, 2026, a climate 5x5 is $38 and a climate 10x10 is $123. The unit list charges a $24 administrative fee at move-in. The company pricing page says there is no admin fee beyond the first month and a small lock fee, and it does not print the lock amount.
address: 1501 Earl Rudder FWY, College Station, TX 77845

fees.label: Administrative fee
fees.note: The unit list the facility page loads charges $24 at move-in on every size. The company pricing page says there are no setup or admin fees beyond the first month and a small lock fee. Checked Nov 28, 2026.

fees.label: Lock fee
fees.note: Premium Spaces says month-to-month rentals have no setup or admin fees beyond the first month and a small lock fee. The lock amount is still not published. Checked Nov 28, 2026.

facts.label: Climate control
facts.value: The facility page lists both climate-controlled and non-climate storage, plus drive-up units.

facts.label: Sizes
facts.value: The published list runs from a 5x5 to a 10x30, and it also includes a 7.5x15 and a 10x12.5. Outside and covered parking are on the unit list, separate from the rooms.

facts.label: Students
facts.value: The page mentions student storage near Texas A&M and summer storage so students do not have to haul belongings home.

facts.label: Lease and reservation
facts.value: Month-to-month leases. The page says you can reserve online for free with no credit card.

facts.label: Other features
facts.value: Deliveries accepted, boat and RV storage, covered parking, and a gate.

facts.label: Office and access hours
facts.value: The page has headings for today's office hours and today's access hours. The times are not in the page content.

facts.label: Outside parking prices
facts.value: Outside and covered parking prices are on the unit list. They are not rooms for boxes.

gaps: Lock fee amount. The company page mentions a small lock fee and does not print it.
